items.claim: Fixed: a layer group's throwing `effects` thunk losing the frame , `
Fixed: a layer named twice in `layerOrder` painting twice , `
items.note: The same mistake sat in `paintedSceneLayers` and the worker stack's `orderedIds`, and both are fixed too. Strict call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: the layer draws once, at its first place, and warns in development.

items.claim: Fixed: `warnLayersOnce` dedupe set growing without bound , `
items.note: It is now capped at 256 messages, oldest out first. No changeset, since this is dev-only.

items.claim: Fixed: `usePointerStylus` `hovering` never true with the default `window` target , `
items.note: The old test dispatched `pointerenter` to `window`, which a browser never does, so it was corrected along with the hook.
plus `8337d4747e`, which rewrote it to pass `react-hooks` lint. Strict call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: an empty ref listens to nothing instead of falling back to `window`.
It now returns the bare word `undefined`, and forge's `coverOf` no longer needs its `?? ' undefined'` guard.

items.claim: Fixed: `stableStringify` tags colliding with real objects , `
items.note: Strict call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: an object with its own `$type` key is written as `{"$type":"object","value":…}`.

items.claim: Fixed: `usePublishSceneSelection` keeping stale kind labels after an in-place edit , `
items.note: The labels now come from `useSyncExternalStore` on the scene.
